anchor: No, John, You Are the Demons
title: Weekly Puzzle #41, in which you might be the Lunatic
selftext:
This week, you finally drew the Imp token! But the Lunatic is on the script – so are you really the Demon?

Please put proposed solutions behind spoiler markup (> and ! at start, then ! and < at end).

Huge thanks to the folks on the [Unofficial Discord's puzzle channel](https://discord.com/channels/569683781800296501/854891541969109033) for their help with playtesting!

[An archive of previous weekly puzzles can be found here.](https://notquitetangible.blogspot.com/2024/11/clocktower-puzzle-archive.html)
